# Draco decoder

These decoder files were retained from the source package alongside Three.js r180. The official [Three.js r180 Draco README](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r180/examples/jsm/libs/draco/README.md) identifies the decoder as Google Draco under Apache 2.0.

`LICENSE` and `AUTHORS` were recovered from the official [Google Draco repository](https://github.com/google/draco) on 2026-10-28. They preserve upstream terms; the decoder binary has not been rebuilt or modified. Exact decoder build revision remains unverified, rather than inferred from the Three.js revision.

Retained decoder SHA256 values:

- `draco_decoder.wasm`: `a680d927bed9cb864ddbd63521868891af2bfbe755092761b4837487618df8ac`.
- `draco_wasm_wrapper.js`: `8bb2952d2ba7d67e1414f8df819410cb0434a666be53f671fff75f68843d76f6`.
